positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently working on Axon 911.

Dec 2024 - July 2026: Led the development of Axon Academy, a learning management system serving 500,000+ law enforcement officers globally.

• Architected the React frontend, integrated .NET APIs, and heavily influenced backend architecture while contributing across the stack.
• Awarded the "Own It" value coin twice by peers. First for leading a high-stakes launch; second for building a comprehensive internal admin dashboard that allowed the customer service and training teams to manage learners entirely within Academy.
• Built an internal admin dashboard that gave customer service and training teams full operational control,  including enrolling and unenrolling learners, assigning instructors to sessions, tracking agency voucher balances, verifying agency admin status, and auditing learner certificates and enrollment history.
• Won 1st place at the VR Pillars Hackathon by prototyping an internal LMS to replace our dependency on a third-party LMS entirely.
• Built a cross-platform Electron app from 0 to 1 that enables Agency Administrators to bulk-register VR headsets and tablets in a single click, eliminating what was previously a tedious manual per-device setup process.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
• Led the migration of headspace.com from Gatsby to Next.js, reducing deployment time from 30 minutes to under 10 seconds.  
• Redesigned checkout flows to enable self-service promotions, enhancing deployment velocity and minimizing operational overhead.  
• Managed a team of 5 engineers, overseeing sprint planning, performance reviews, and hiring for the Membership squad.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Built Marketing Center, a browser-based design platform enabling 30,000+ real estate agents to create customizable postcards, brochures, and digital marketing materials 
•  Developed core canvas editor features—element grouping, rotation, resizing, and multiselect—using React and the Moveable library, forming the foundation of a flexible design system 
•  Implemented print-to-PDF export pipeline enabling seamless conversion of digital designs to high-quality physical print materials 
•  Established deployment workflows, code review standards, and onboarding documentation for a 4-person engineering team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and built a customizable report-writing framework for Axon Records, enhancing usability for law enforcement agencies.  
• Developed a rich-text editing library in React, improving consistency across multiple web applications.  
• Mentored junior engineers through pair programming and code reviews, fostering a collaborative team environment.
